i01.note: man in green shirt 'sits on a wooden bench, reading an open red book'

i02.note: 'a small blue bird is standing on the bench right next to it [the sandwich], apparently pecking at it'; the unsure section adds that it could be just standing there, but pecking is the main reading

i03.note: 'The man is looking at his book and does not seem to notice, so the bird may be about to steal or eat his sandwich'

i04.note: said she holds 'something small and pink up to her mouth or nose', a flower she is smelling or a sweet or lollipop she is eating; no ice cream or cone named, and eating is only one of two readings

i05.note: 'a sunny day in a park, with a bright yellow sun in the top left'

i08.note: 'a blue pond with bulrushes at both ends'

i09.note: 'a large tree on the far left', plus a line of trees in the background

i10.note: 'A tall black lamp post stands in the centre behind the bench'

i11.note: 'a flower bed of brightly coloured flowers in the front right'

unintended: the bird and the sandwich are drawn overlapping and are hard to tell apart at a glance [bird, three-quarter front]
the lamp post is very tall and thin compared with the trees (the describer put it down to style)
